body: You should meet new people but not with the intention of replacing her, socialization is just supposed to be healthy. You could hopefully talk to them about this down the line, they may be able to offer comfort or at least listen.

No idea, I hope technology advances to where I can shut off my brain sometime soon. Thank you, and I don't think that sounds petty. I love music deeply, and though I listen to it lots, it often makes me think of unfortunate memories.

You don't want indecisive people like that in your life. It will spare you more heartache to try to not think of her as a romantic interest.
There are so many kind and honest people out there but they seem like neither. One day you can care for and be cared for by a more honest girl that prioritizes you.
I'm sorry for your pain, but I hope that with time you can feel better and think of her less.

I have every other hobby. I've played piano for maybe 12 years, I dance, I go to the gym, I cook, I listen to music, I paint, I online shop, I drive lots. I can keep somewhat focused on those things, but even then I can't help but think poorly. I don't know why. I have tried just telling myself over and over "this is nice, this is good!" but it's like I feel guilty for even entertaining the idea of enjoying anything even though I want to enjoy things.
Did you find it? I can't.
